title: Sperm sampling and insect-like faces

tellings.quote: in the second session, their faces finally came through and I remember screaming, "They're bugs. They look like bugs."

plain: Jim Weiner, one of a group of men on a camping trip on the Allagash Waterway in Maine in August 1976, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he was taken aboard a craft where beings took samples of his sperm. He says that in a second session of recalling the event, their faces finally came back to him and he remembers screaming that they looked like bugs.
